name: Estonian Business School
summary: Business university in Tallinn with three English-taught bachelor's: international business, entrepreneurship, and product and technology management.

ib.text: IB Diploma needs at least 24 points, EE and TOK at D or better, every HL course 3+ (HL total 12+) and one SL course may be a 2 (SL total 9+). English B2 must be proved by test, then a 20-minute interview.

lastYear.text: EU/EEA window 1 Feb–1 Apr; page shows no year

programmes.name: International Business Administration
programmes.about: Business fundamentals, then a specialisation in finance and accounting or in marketing and communication, with two internships and a mobility window; a double degree with Lancaster University Management School is possible.
programmes.ib: Sufficient maths results are asked, with no minimum grade published; ask the admissions office what counts.

needs.note: Page says 'sufficient mathematics results'; no grade is stated.

programmes.selectionNote: No entrance exam: a threshold (60% of top GPA, IB at least 24) and a 20-minute online interview. 2026 criteria; 2027 not yet published.

programmes.name: Impactful Entrepreneurship
programmes.about: Learn entrepreneurship by building your own business idea through a simulation that follows a company from first concept to growth or exit, guided by entrepreneurs and mentors, with two internships.
programmes.selectionNote: No entrance exam: a threshold (60% of top GPA, IB at least 24) and a 20-minute online interview. 2026 criteria; 2027 not yet published.

programmes.name: Product and Technology Management
programmes.about: Combines product management, technology and business to take digital products from user need to launch, through projects, simulations and internships; developed with the coding school //kood.
programmes.selectionNote: No entrance exam: a threshold (60% of top GPA, IB at least 24) and a 20-minute online interview. 2026 criteria; 2027 not yet published.

notes: EU/EEA applicants pay no €120 application fee, and tuition is the same for EU and non-EU students; it is invoiced per semester.
Finnish and Latvian applicants have their own, later application window.
Interviews run once a month online; you are told the result within 7 days and are then conditionally accepted until your final documents are checked.

sources.title: EBS: international admissions (IB and application steps)
